thread:
Naveen: AuroraCloud asked for a compact partner refkit to speed listings. Needs: a single terraform module (AWS first), a tiny Helm chart, and minimal security docs. Single-region MVP.

Claire: ok. Keep variables tiny: region, instance_type, image, enable_kms. Optional: private registry env pattern.

Ravi: propose repo `redwood-aurora-refkit` with layout: terraform/aws/, charts/, examples/basic/, docs/security.md. TF module provisions VPC + nodegroup + ALB and outputs endpoint for helm.

Sana: include OIDC toggle and a note about least-priv IAM. Add kv-cache persistence toggle for faster cold starts.

Naveen: CI? We need tf fmt/validate, helm lint, and a smoke deploy that curls /health then teardown. Use tiny instances for tests.

Ravi: will scaffold tf + helm today and open PR.

Claire: I'll own docs and the marketplace metadata template.

infra-bot: Repo created: github.com/redwood-inference/aurora-refkit (private). Branch: main.

Naveen: target demo to Aurora in 9 days (1718890000). Owners: Ravi (code), Claire (docs), Sana (security checklist). Keep it prescriptive and minimal.

Sana: will draft acceptance criteria and ping legal for listing terms.

Ravi: PR incoming.

(End of thread)
